lede: Seventeen feeds, and only two stories managed to appear on more than one of them: Elizabeth Holmes, who drew 188,874 Wikipedia views while searchers asked whether she is still in jail, and a cat caught mid-judgment of someone's new planter. Wikipedia's own race was tighter than that cross-feed silence suggested, with the Clayface film page taking first at 231,483 views, just 6,792 ahead of the UFC 333 card. Underneath the noise, developers pulled in one direction: Cloudflare's new security-audit skill gained 2,264 stars in a day to top GitHub. The ground stayed quietest of all, with 25 quakes and nothing larger than an M6.5 near Japan's Bonin Islands.

throughlines.title: Elizabeth Holmes
throughlines.gist: The Theranos founder was the only news story to surface on two feeds at once, drawing 188,874 Wikipedia readers while search traffic circled whether she is still behind bars.

throughlines.title: Interior decorator kitty would like a word about your new planter. Photo from my collection, no date/info.
throughlines.gist: A single CatsOfYore post, a cat sizing up a new planter, was the only other item to cross feeds, landing on both Bluesky and Mastodon the same day.

throughlines.title: cloudflare/security-audit-skill
throughlines.gist: Cloudflare's security-audit skill, a coding-agent tool for machine-verified vulnerability findings, added 2,264 stars in a day to lead GitHub trending.
